_meta.status: REVIEWED — academic sign-off 2026-08-15 (INTERFACE.md §5 gate; first recorded mapping version — v0.1.0 release manifest shipped with "none")
_meta.basis: espeak-ng 1.52.0 phsource/ph_latin + main phoneme table; every mnemonic verified non-silent against the native 1.52.0 binary (2026-08-13 probe); additions z / pʰ tʰ kʰ verified non-silent against the wasm build (2026-08-15 probe)
_meta.conventions: Input IPA must be NFC. Diphthongs must carry U+032F COMBINING INVERTED BREVE BELOW on the off-glide (aɪ̯), otherwise two consecutive vowel symbols read as hiatus; the diphthong keys below are the only accepted diphthong notation. Consonant gemination is canonically written with U+02D0 (tː); doubled spellings (tt) degrade to two successive phonemes (near-identical acoustics per 2026-08-15 probe, but non-canonical). Long vowels use U+02D0 (aː). The ui of cui/huic is realized as ʊ+j — ph_latin has no uI diphthong (an unknown mnemonic silently degrades to u+I hiatus). Aspirated stops pʰ/tʰ/kʰ (Greek loanwords, golden-age target) map to stop+h sequences; ph_latin's h is the ʰ modifier.
reviewResolutions: r-sounds (2026-08-15): single r = R (trill, Allen Vox Latina); geminate rː = R: (probe: R: ≈ RR acoustically, both non-silent). The ɾ tap alias was removed — a hard error on ɾ input surfaces caller bugs (INTERFACE.md §4).
Short-vowel quality (2026-08-15): canonical caller output uses lax symbols ɪ ʊ ɛ ɔ for short i/u/e/o (Allen ch. 2; matches espeak la lax targets); tense aliases kept for input tolerance.
ui diphthong (2026-08-15): cui/huic = [kʊj]/[hʊj] via existing ʊ + j phonemes; no uI row (see conventions).
Aspiration (2026-08-15): included as pʰ/tʰ/kʰ → stop + h sequences (ph_latin defines h as the ʰ modifier; probe non-silent). Not simplified to plain p/t/k.
z (2026-08-15): z row added (base-table phoneme; probe non-silent, RMS ≈ s). Callers emit [zd] for Greek loanwords per Allen.
